title: Coat Check: Free Menu Bar Manager for Mac Notch Icons
description: Coat Check is a free, open-source Mac menu bar app that lists every menu bar icon, including the ones the notch hides, and opens their menus for you.
og_title: Coat Check: every menu bar icon, within reach
og_description: The notch hides your menu bar icons. Coat Check hands them back. Free and open source for macOS 14 and later.
